_doc: [extras] Songs on the base radio (systems/extras/radio.gd). id: a composed track (audio/music_tracks.gd, played with Audio.play_track; name: its title as in Audio.music_track_title, kept here so it gets extracted and translated; a restored planet plays its restored variant). cond: when it unlocks, the condition types of data/achievements.json plus 'districts_l5' (bases at level 5), 'districts' (districts visited), 'planet_seen' (key: planet theme id, heard on that planet) and 'planet_level' (key: planet; best base level reached on that planet). No cond = on the radio from the start. hint: shown while locked. Unlocks persist in GameState.flags.radio.unlocked.

songs.name: Sprout Step
songs.desc: Kalimba and bells, the first green on Verdance.

songs.name: Clean Sweep
songs.desc: Marimba and a four-on-the-floor kick: cleaning music.

songs.name: Sunbaked
songs.desc: A sunny marimba hook over a lute ostinato.

songs.name: Dune Caravan
songs.desc: A winding pluck line over a loping frame drum.
songs.hint: A base on Ochre at level 3

songs.name: Mirage
songs.desc: Kalimba and bells shimmering in the heat.
songs.hint: A base on Ochre at level 5

songs.name: Tradewinds
songs.desc: Steel pans skipping over the waves.

songs.name: Tidepools
songs.desc: A harp melody over rolling arpeggios.
songs.hint: A base on Tidewell at level 3

songs.name: Skipping Stones
songs.hint: A base on Tidewell at level 5

songs.name: Hoarfrost
songs.desc: Glass bells that slowly gather warmth.

songs.name: Aurora
songs.desc: Piano doubled by glass under the northern lights.
songs.hint: A base on Rime at level 5

songs.name: Foundry Heart
songs.desc: A dark, groovy forge that learns to hope.

songs.name: Ash Choir
songs.desc: An eerie choir over brass and embers.
songs.hint: A base on Anvil at level 3

songs.name: Red Engine
songs.desc: Sub bass and metal hits, the furnaces running clean.
songs.hint: A base on Anvil at level 5

songs.name: Homecoming
songs.desc: The ark's theme, for the journey home.
